acceptanceCriteria: Darwin identity records the resolved git binary hash or explicitly labels shim hashing; test covers both cases.
body: Found by the ci-shadow-historical-compat lane. The frozen identity's Git SHA-256 on macOS is of /usr/bin/git, an xcrun shim, so two hosts with different real Git versions can share a hash (the version field still differs). Expected: resolve the shim (xcrun --find git) or record that the hash is of the shim.
title: corvint-pr-tests: on Darwin the frozen Git identity hashes the /usr/bin/git xcrun shim, not the real git binary
